intent: Polish the command palette so it reads as the cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud command graph launcher instead of a generic action search modal.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added SSR-static command proof strip with FD-001 tenant workload, Oyatie Cloud, REC-WF-7741, and cell-us-east-2 context.
Added command proof shortcuts for FD-001 product graph, cloud substrate cells, evidence receipt, and local boundary explanation.
Added visible command status updates for proof actions and search filtering.
Extended command palette interactions to route proof shortcuts to product graph, cloud topology, and audit ledger without closing the palette.
Expanded command palette layout and CSS so proof, results, and local-only boundary footer fit as one dense command surface.

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud command graph launcher
visual_verdict.reasoning: The command palette now presents one cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud command graph with proof shortcuts, receipt/cell context, visible search state, and explicit local-only boundaries.
differences: Commands remain local visual routes and deliberately do not execute workflows, send mail, mutate IAM, billing, deploy, or cloud state.
suggestions: Future production wiring can bind command actions to tenant command APIs while preserving the proof/status hierarchy.

commands.summary: ready-after-3s; transient empty replies immediately after restart

known_limits: Visual prototype only; command palette actions do not execute workflows, send mail, mutate IAM/auth, change billing, deploy resources, or mutate cloud/provider state.
This slice improves the command palette; it does not prove the full dashboard/mockup objective complete.
